swarm_render_overhead — DRIVE swarmflow op

• Data kinds: matrix × any × scalar → image2d

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.swarm_render_overhead(points, shape, res: 'float', center=(0.0, 0.0), diameter_px: 'float' = 3.0, intensity: 'float' = 1.0, background: 'float' = 0.0) -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import swarmflow; swarmflow.swarm_render_overhead(points, shape, res: 'float', center=(0.0, 0.0), diameter_px: 'float' = 3.0, intensity: 'float' = 1.0, background: 'float' = 0.0) -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("swarm_render_overhead"))

Usage

Individual positions → 1 overhead frame (Gaussian bright spots, diameter = 2 × standard deviation = the PIV convention, same as pivops).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.
